authority.expected_value_provider: independent arithmetic reconstruction; sparse_attn semantics reused from Boundary 3

non_claims: does not validate inverse rotary, wo_a, wo_b, full Attention output, decode cache/ring behavior, Block/HC, logits, full model correctness, performance, or fusion

functions.name: Attention._compress_kv
functions.reviewed: prefill compressed offset and ratio=1 compress_len

functions.name: Attention.forward
functions.reviewed: kv cat [window, compressed]; topk cat [window, compressed+offset]; sparse_attn call

operation_contract.index_assembly: topk_idxs = cat([window_topk_idxs, compressed_topk_idxs_after_offset], dim=-1), where compressed offset is window_kv length
operation_contract.ratio1_compressor: compress_ratio=1 forms singleton groups; softmax over group dimension is exactly 1 and each token yields one compressed latent/KV row
operation_contract.sparse_attn: Boundary 3 sparse_attn over concatenated KV/topk; STOP before inverse rotary / output projection

purpose: Boundary 5e layer-24 window KV + compressed KV/index assembly into sparse_attn; stop after sparse_attn output
